name: BOLD Summer Camp (BioCONECT Oncology Leadership Development), Rutgers Cancer Institute
org: Rutgers Cancer Institute and Rutgers School of Public Health
what_you_do: Spend a week at Rutgers Cancer Institute. You learn the biology and genes of cancer and how it is found and treated. You also learn how to lower risk and what jobs exist in the field.
who_can_apply: High school students entering 10th, 11th or 12th grade in the fall. Only 45 students were accepted in 2026. Applicants write a five paragraph personal response.
pay_detail: No application fee. Accepted students paid a non-refundable $500 enrollment fee in 2026 (due June 1, 2026).
duration: 1 week, 9:30 am to 4:00 pm (July 20 to 24 in 2026)
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed (acceptances by May 15, 2026). 2027 dates not posted. Join the mailing list at BOLD@cinj.rutgers.edu.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application and write the five paragraph answer. Questions: BOLD@cinj.rutgers.edu.
notes: Two groups run it. They are the LIFE Center at Rutgers Cancer Institute and the Center for School and Community-Based Research and Education. A reunion camp is open to past campers.
